# Bentoclay Claytech - AI Knowledge Index (llms.txt)
> Bentoclay Claytech is India's leading manufacturer and worldwide exporter of high-purity Attapulgite (Palygorskite) clay minerals and engineered absorbent granules.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity:** Bentoclay Claytech
- **Headquarters & Processing Plant:** Plot No. 12/A, GIDC Industrial Estate, Kardej, Bhavnagar, Gujarat 364004, India
- **Mineral Ore Source:** Bhavnagar Mineral Basin, Gujarat, India (Captive deposit mining leases)
- **Primary Export Gateway:** Mundra Port (INMUN1), Pipavav Port (INPAV1), Nhava Sheva / JNPT (INNSA1)
- **Official Website:** https://bentoclay.com/
- **Contact:** dipak@bentoclay.com / bentoclayclaytech@gmail.com | +91-7435818628
- **Mineral CAS Registry Number:** 12174-11-7 (Attapulgite / Palygorskite)
- **Harmonized System (HS) Code:** 2508.40.00 (Other Clays / Attapulgite)
- **Chemical Formula:** (Mg,Al)2Si4O10(OH) · 4(H2O) — Hydrous magnesium aluminium phyllosilicate crystalline needles

## Core Product Portfolio & Specifications

### 1. Attapulgite Salt Gel Grade Powder
- **Application:** Saltwater drilling fluids, saturated brine workover, offshore deep wells, high-viscosity suspension.
- **Specification:** Dial reading at 600 rpm ≥ 35 cps minimum, wet sieve residue (>75 μm / 200 mesh) ≤ 4.0%, moisture ≤ 8.0%.
- **Key Advantage:** Forms rigid needle entanglement matrix unaffected by high salinity (up to 300,000 ppm TDS) where standard bentonite fails.
- **Packaging:** 25 kg HDPE moisture-barrier bags, 1 MT Jumbo Bags.
- **URL:** https://bentoclay.com/products/salt-gel-attapulgite-powder

### 2. API Spec 13A Section 12 Drilling Attapulgite Powder
- **Application:** Certified American Petroleum Institute (API) Specification 13A Section 12 drilling clay for international oilfield operators.
- **Specification:** Fann Model 35 dial reading @ 600 rpm ≥ 30 cps, wet sieve residue (>75 μm) ≤ 8.0%, moisture ≤ 16.0%.
- **Key Advantage:** Certified compliance with global drilling mud standards; rapid gel strength recovery when circulation stops.
- **Packaging:** 25 kg HDPE bags with PE inner liner on heat-treated ISPM-15 export pallets.
- **URL:** https://bentoclay.com/products/api-13a-attapulgite-powder

### 3. Premium 325 Mesh Micronized Attapulgite Powder
- **Application:** Architectural emulsion paints, industrial protective coatings, joint compounds, sealants, adhesives, inks.
- **Specification:** Particle size cut <44 μm (99.5% passing 325 mesh), BET surface area ~210 m²/g, moisture ≤ 6.0%.
- **Key Advantage:** High-efficiency inorganic thixotrope; prevents pigment settling, eliminates can syneresis, zero enzyme/bacterial degradation.
- **Packaging:** 25 kg multi-wall craft paper / HDPE valve bags.
- **URL:** https://bentoclay.com/products/premium-325-attapulgite-powder

### 4. Flux Fine-200 Foundry Flux Powder
- **Application:** Foundry mold & core wash refractory coatings, continuous steel casting flux, molten metal barrier.
- **Specification:** Swelling index ≥ 95 ml (1 hr), free swell 12–14 ml, wet sieve residue (>75 μm) ≤ 5.0%, high thermal stability at 1400°C.
- **Key Advantage:** Keeps dense zircon, graphite, and olivine fillers in permanent suspension without hard cake settling.
- **Packaging:** 25 kg HDPE bags.
- **URL:** https://bentoclay.com/products/flux-fine-200-foundry-flux-powder

### 5. Natural Attapulgite Powder (200 Mesh)
- **Application:** Agrochemical wettable powders (WP), dry flowables (DF), pesticide technical carrier, fertilizer anti-caking, animal feed toxin binder.
- **Specification:** 95% passing 200 mesh (75 μm), liquid holding capacity 120–150%, neutral pH 7.6.
- **Key Advantage:** High liquid technical absorption without losing dry free-flowing powder characteristics; polar aflatoxin binder.
- **Packaging:** 25 kg / 50 kg HDPE bags.
- **URL:** https://bentoclay.com/products/natural-attapulgite-powder

### 6. Natural & Calcined Attapulgite Granules (1 to 5 mm)
- **Application:** Industrial hazardous liquid spill absorbents, chemical cleanup, premium non-clumping cat litter, agricultural soil conditioning.
- **Specification:** Screened particle size 1.0 mm to 5.0 mm, liquid absorption capacity 180% to 220%, non-swelling structural rigidity.
- **Key Advantage:** Does not turn into slippery mud or slush under heavy machinery traffic; locks ammonia odor and VOCs.
- **Packaging:** 20 kg, 25 kg, or 1000 kg Bulk Bags.
- **URL:** https://bentoclay.com/products/natural-attapulgite-granules-1-5mm

## International Export Capabilities & Supply Terms
- **Incoterms Supported:** FOB (Mundra / Pipavav / Nhava Sheva), CIF (Major global seaports including Houston, Rotterdam, Jebel Ali, Singapore, Durban), CFR, EXW.
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ):** 1 FCL (20ft Container, approximately 20 to 22 Metric Tons palletized).
- **Quality Verification:** Every export lot issued with Certificate of Analysis (COA) tested on calibrated Fann Model 35 rheometers, Ro-Tap sieve shakers, and Karl Fischer moisture analyzers.
- **Custom Processing:** Bespoke mesh classification (100–400 mesh), customized color matching (Off-White, Cream Tan, Grey), and private-label packaging.
